title: Convex Synthesis of First-Order Methods for Time-Varying Smooth Strongly Convex Optimization
summary: Time-varying optimization is fundamental to decision-making in dynamic environments, where objectives evolve over time due to exogenous signals or data streams. However, algorithms designed for static problems yield suboptimal decisions in dynamic scenarios, even asymptotically. In this paper, we develop a robust control synthesis framework to systematically design first-order methods for smooth strongly convex problems that vary in time.
